name: permission-matrix
title: Permission Matrix
description: Roles across, permissions down, a checkbox or switch in every cell. A WAI-ARIA grid: one Tab stop, arrows move between cells, Home and End go to the row ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the corners, Space toggles. Each cell is named by its permission and role headers.
